items.title: QYO — Quantum-Classical Hybrid Metaheuristic
items.subtitle: Co-authored with Prof. Gajanan V Honnavar
items.description: Four-layer pipelined architecture unifying SA warm-start, QWalk-MCMC exploration, and adaptive Grover amplification. Outperformed QAOA by 15.3–21.4 pp on Weighted Max-Cut. Validated on IBM ibm_fez 156-qubit NISQ at depth 119.

items.title: YO — Classical Hybrid Optimization
items.subtitle: Co-authored with Prof. Gajanan V Honnavar
items.description: Three-layer MCMC + greedy + adaptive SA framework. Ranked 2nd on Rosenbrock 5D with fastest runtime (0.061s). Delivered 1.8% shorter TSP tours at N=200. Open-source on GitHub.

items.title: Origo Signum — Quantum PUF
items.subtitle: Co-authored with Prof. Gajanan V Honnavar
items.description: 3-qubit quantum circuit exploiting NISQ decoherence as controlled entropy. Achieved 9.38-bit Shannon entropy (≈91% of max) on IBM ibm_fez. Validated on Qiskit Aer.

items.title: Quantum Cryptography — BB84 QKD
items.subtitle: Quantum Key Distribution Implementation
items.description: Implemented and stress-tested BB84 QKD circuits, verifying protocol integrity under simulated channel noise on IBM Quantum Experience.
